articles.summary: Vancouver, BC and Rehovot, Israel, September 3, 2026- BioHarvest Sciences Inc. (Nasdaq: BHST) (FSE: 8MV0), a leader in Botanical Synthesis technology and sustainable plant-based molecule development today announced its intention to offer its ordinary shares on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE) and to become dual-listed for trade on both the Nasdaq and TASE markets.
articles.title: BioHarvest Sciences Registers for Dual Listing on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE)
